impacted.role: `build_llm_analysis` (line 52) builds the stored analysis for both the daemon pipeline (orchestrator.py:168) and `analyze repair` (cli/src/cli/analyze.py:198) and sets `title_only` from `is_readable(content)` at line 84; it receives the summary, the evaluation and the content, not the fetcher's analysis

`is_readable` returns a bare boolean from placeholder checks, the has-prose rule and the JavaScript-wall rule; callers are analysis.py, orchestrator.py (readmit), storage.py (refetch selection), refetch.py, fetchers/rss.py and fetchers/reddit.py
`extract_article` (line 19) returns None for a failed download, an empty extraction and any exception alike; called by fetchers/rss.py, fetchers/reddit.py and refetch.py

`_extract_transcript` (line 334) returns None on any failure (HTTP 429 or no subtitles alike) and `_process_video` falls through to `_handle_missing_transcript` (lines 305, 314); items carry `analysis={"metrics": ...}`

`summarize_with_analysis` parses one JSON object and validates five required fields; the standard prompt's OUTPUT FORMAT (line 297) serves standard, brief and detailed modes, and the diff prompt (line 386) serves file sources

merges fetcher analysis into the LLM analysis, keeping metrics and every fetcher key the LLM analysis lacks; skips deep extraction for title_only (line 225); skips re-analysing a stored title-only item whose fresh content still fails `is_readable` (line 423)
`get_readable_external_ids` treats title_only NULL or 0 as stored readably (lines 690-691); every other stored item is re-extracted each fetch cycle
prints id, title, priority, kind and published, with no title-only marker; cli/src/cli/get.py prints the entry with no title-only marker

constraints.text: Success, empty success, and failure are three answers and never share a representation.
Anything running unattended (scheduled, triggered, retried, backgrounded) records what it decided, and why, at the moment it decides.
Content that is not readable is stored with `analysis.title_only = true`; it stays in the feed, skips deep extraction, and shows a marker in TUI and web.
The ten kinds and the 0.7 threshold change only with new measurement (gh #77).
The merge copies every fetcher analysis key the LLM analysis lacks into the stored analysis, so a fetcher-supplied fetch outcome reaches storage without a new path.
Stored summaries for 9 known-junk items (HN youtube.com links, grapheneos.social walls): 7 say 'no substantive information' or 'no substantive content', 2 summarize the title as if it were content.

An item marked title-only by the model alone would be re-extracted every cycle, pass the code check at orchestrator.py:423, and be re-analysed each time, so the retry query must treat model-only title-only items as settled.
